name: Group Bulk Operations
description: Bulk actions on groups via Views.
project_description:
This module creates an Action plugin that can assign/update a user's group role and update owner of the group for multiple groups in once. 

 When you are managing a site with many groups, it could be painful to update a user's role or owner of the group for multiple groups, e.g. giving a user admin role in tens of groups, which requires changing configurations repeatedly for each group . This module provides the capability to update a user's roles for as many groups as you want in one time.

 Usage: 
 
 Add "Bulk Update" field to group list view

 
 
 Ensure "Assign group role and Remove Group User" is in Action selected

 
 
 Select the group that the user's role to be changed on the group list view page, apply the action
